customManagers.description: Lego is installed via a curl'd GitHub release tarball in the Dockerfile, not a base image -- Dependabot's docker ecosystems can't see it, so Renovate watches it directly against go-acme/lego's GitHub releases.

packageRules.description: Dependabot already covers Dockerfile base image + docker-compose images (see .github/dependabot.yml) -- Renovate here is scoped to the Lego custom manager only, to avoid two bots opening competing PRs for the same bump.
